commands: python scripts/dev/tasks.py done nb-live-tree-deploy-cleanup --result "AutoDeploy clean: <log line>"
done_when: Next MTS-AutoDeploy log shows no STOP_DIRTY/STOP_MERGE and live HEAD equals green/fast-track; every moved/archived file is listed in the card result.
goal: Let MTS-AutoDeploy fast-forward the live tree to green/fast-track by restoring files whose live-only lines already sit on origin (cddac741) and moving untracked files that are byte-identical to origin.
scope_in: live tree (folder holding .mts_live) on JIS-NB: DSA_SESSION_PROMPT.md, MyTradingSys/items/INDEX.md, research/BUGS.md, research/apparatus_fixes.md, runtime/session_log.json, two deleted files, scripts/dev/live_mirror.py
20 untracked files under MyTradingSys/backtest/bigtrade and research/bigtrade_2026-10-09
scope_out: stopping/restarting processes, HALT files, opening trades
stash, reset, clean, force: archive by copy/move only
files that differ from origin without their lines being on origin: report, do not restore
steps: git -C <live> status --short; for each dirty file run git -C <live> diff origin/fast-track -- <f> and confirm the live-only lines are on origin (cddac741). If not, copy the file to runtime_data/deploy_backup and report.
Copy runtime/session_log.json to runtime_data/deploy_backup first, then git -C <live> checkout -- <path> for each of the 7 files plus scripts/dev/live_mirror.py.
For each untracked bigtrade file compare git hash-object <f> with git rev-parse origin/fast-track:<path>; identical ones move to runtime_data/deploy_backup, any other stays and is reported.
Run the deploy by hand only if MTS-AutoDeploy is down (DEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md); otherwise wait one 15-minute cycle and read its log.
tests: none (ops); evidence = AutoDeploy log line and git -C <live> status clean
title: JIS-NB live tree: clear the dirty/untracked files that make AutoDeploy stop (STOP_DIRTY, then STOP_MERGE)
